methodology: Audit boundaries: current-source fixtures, not live production DB, no engine/model launched, no user data reads required. Production-mode fixture timings and test-mode counter suites separated. CDP JSHeapUsedSize after GC is retained JS heap, not RSS or GPU memory. DOM count is querySelectorAll('*'), excludes text nodes; transcript descendant count separate. Row detection plus 2 rAFs is interaction-ready proxy, not React render duration, app boot or presentation guarantee. 120 programmatic scroll frames/sample; frames >50ms; no manual smoothness judgement. Three repetitions per size/content, fixed order (cold first sample not excluded), no statistical significance claims. Context API, generation, attachments and provider bridge stubbed; exact IPC overhead/inference not measured. Polling counters use fake timers and ten probes, not observed whole-shell idle CPU. Idle TaskDuration includes end-of-window GC; do not report as idle CPU. Existing system workload changed available RAM, impacts absolute timings. Background harness reuses synthetic Phase3.2 assets read-only, compiles current component and current CSS; helpers applied directly rather than user settings. Hardware status must be observed, not inferred from host GPU model.

import os,subprocess,pathlib,json,time
r=pathlib.Path.cwd(); d=pathlib.Path('/tmp/continuum-phase7'); results=[]
def run(name,cmd):
 t=time.monotonic()
 try:
  p=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=150,env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k!='ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE'}); code=p.returncode; out=p.stdout
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e: code=124;out=str(e.stdout)
 (d/(name+'.log')).write_text(out); results.append(dict(name=name,command=cmd,exit=code,seconds=round(time.monotonic()-t,2))); (d/'checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)); print(name,code,flush=True)
run('unit',['node','--test']+[str(p) for p in r.joinpath('tests').iterdir() if p.name in ['terminalLogStore.test.mjs','transcriptWindow.test.mjs','chatSearch.test.mjs','sidebarAnimation.test.cjs','backgroundGifBounding.test.cjs','backgroundSettings.test.cjs','uiLayerOpacity.test.cjs','tabPersistence.test.mjs','palacePolling.test.cjs','messageIdentity.test.mjs']])
for name in ['terminalLogIsolation','chatPagination','chatFindNavigation','sidebarAnimation','renderIsolation','palaceStability','tabContextPersistence','tabSwitchIsolation','backgroundLayer','chatInputPerformance','palacePolling']:
 wrapper=d/(name+'.cjs'); profile=d/('profile-'+name)
 wrapper.write_text("const {app}=require("+json.dumps('electron')+");app.setPath('userData',"+json.dumps(str(profile))+");require("+json.dumps(str(r/'tests'/(name+'.ui.cjs')))+");")
 run(name,['xvfb-run','-a',str(r/'node_modules/electron/dist/electron'),'--no-sandbox',str(wrapper)])
run('build',['node','node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js','build','--outDir',str(d/'build')])
